county_relationship.note: Counties come from each facility's resolved county. A ZIP can span several counties; the HUD USPS crosswalk (with weights) is not yet configured. Census ZCTAs approximate, but are not, USPS ZIP codes.

top_deficiency_types.title: Develop, implement, and/or maintain an effective training program for all new and existing staff members.

Timely report suspected abuse, neglect, or theft and report the results of the investigation to proper authorities.

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide care or services that was trauma informed and/or culturally competent.
